title: Shara'i' al-Islam fi Masa'il al-Halal wa al-Haram
originalTitle: شرائع الإسلام في مسائل الحلال والحرام
author: al-muhaqqiq-al-hilli
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: The standard handbook of Twelver Shia law, in four parts: acts of worship, contracts, unilateral acts and judgements. Its clear order and careful statement of the school's positions made it the base text of the Shia seminaries for seven centuries.
historicalContext: Al-Muhaqqiq al-Hilli led the scholars of al-Hilla in Iraq after the Mongol conquest. The Shara'i' was commented on by al-Shahid al-Thani and, in the nineteenth century, in the vast Jawahir al-Kalam.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
